notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten 2026 sheets tie White Bird Days/White Bird Rodeo to Salmon River Chamber outreach and Jeannie at 208-305-8052. Adventure Zone Gmail confirms 2026 outreach and a later chamber reply that the local market is small and standard pricing would be difficult to recoup; Adventure Zone offered pay-for-play as an alternative. Source: handwritten call notes, pages 69/115; Adventure Zone Gmail.
